انبطحت (form VII)
# اِنْبَطَحْتُ (inbaṭaḥtu) /in.ba.tˤaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# اِنْبَطَحْتَ (inbaṭaḥta) /in.ba.tˤaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# اِنْبَطَحْتِ (inbaṭaḥti) /in.ba.tˤaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# اِنْبَطَحَتْ (inbaṭaḥat) /in.ba.tˤa.ħat/: third-pe
